# Portfolio Pruning

Report 034 | Published 2020-09-20 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2020-9-20/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/034.json)

Portfolio simplification and a defined Tesla short.

The Tesla setup failed its stated stop condition after an initial favorable move. Five-year sensitivities sharply separate successful Facebook exposure from losing Alibaba and JD exposure. Portfolio simplification and income improvement require holdings-level reconstruction, so they are not credited as automatic performance gains.

**Coverage:** All numbered text blocks and image labels read. Material theses, forecasts and explanations are included; routine holdings lists, incidental statistics, company descriptions and boilerplate are excluded. Chart pixels were not inspected.

### 034-C02

**Oneok faces permanent impairment**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Mixed |
| Type | investment thesis |
| Horizon | Not specified |
| Conditions | Not specified |
| Author modality | asserted |
| Asset or variable | OKE |
| Source blocks | 5 |
| Thesis family | oneok-capital-impairment |

The concern was grounded in actual asset impairments, but a permanent loss of the company-wide earnings franchise is too strong: 2020 adjusted EBITDA rose despite the write-downs. OKE then returned 212.07% and 267.91% in the three- and five-year sensitivities from this report. Accounting impairment and durable shareholder impairment are different propositions.

**Direction:** See independently checked outcomes and qualifications in reason.

**Timing:** No fixed endpoint supplied.

**Mechanism:** Business performance and shareholder return are distinct.

**Reviewer confidence:** medium

**Outcome evidence:**

- [ONEOK full-year 2020 results](https://ir.oneok.com/news-and-events/press-releases/2021/02-22-2021-211628375) | ONEOK | 2021-02-22 | Verified in the audit

2020 included $644.9 million noncash impairments. Adjusted EBITDA nevertheless rose 6% to $2.724 billion; dividend coverage declined to 1.17 from 1.38.

- [OKE historical price sensitivity](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/OKE/history/) | Yahoo Finance | Verified in the audit

3-year comparison 2020-09-21 to 2023-09-20: OKE +212.07% cumulative, 46.22% annualized; SPY +40.28% cumulative. 5-year comparison 2020-09-21 to 2025-09-19: OKE +267.91% cumulative, 29.80% annualized; SPY +117.73% cumulative. First common close strictly after publication, last common close on/before anniversary. USD vendor-adjusted-close proxies include vendor dividend/split adjustments; no fees, taxes or actual subscriber trades. These are evaluator-defined sensitivities unless the claim explicitly names the horizon.

### 034-C12

**Tesla rebound fails below 500**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Wrong |
| Type | forecast |
| Horizon | until 500 stop or thesis exit |
| Conditions | Price remains below 500 in 2020 units |
| Author modality | asserted |
| Asset or variable | TSLA |
| Source blocks | 65, 66 |
| Thesis family | tesla-september2020-short |

The price first fell, but then crossed the explicit 500 invalidation level on November 19, 2020. Without an earlier specified profit-taking rule, the lower-high thesis failed its own stop condition. This is not a reconstructed executed short.

**Direction:** See reason; no return inferred.

**Timing:** Original horizon retained: until 500 stop or thesis exit

**Mechanism:** Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

**Reviewer confidence:** high

**Outcome evidence:**

- [Tesla 2020 short invalidation path](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/TSLA/history/) | Yahoo Finance | Verified in the audit

Following September 20, 2020, first daily high above split-adjusted 166.6667 occurred November 19: high 169.5367 (=508.61 in 2020 units). September 21 close 149.7967 (=449.39), September 24 close 129.2633 (=387.79). Initial favorable move preceded stop breach; no actual fill, borrow cost or prior exit verified.

- [Three-for-one split](https://ir.tesla.com/press-release/tesla-announces-three-one-stock-split?source=syndication) | Tesla | 2022-08-05 | Verified in the audit

Tesla declared 3:1 split, trading adjusted August 25, 2022. Therefore a 2020$500 threshold corresponds to $166.6667 in vendor back-adjusted historical OHLC.

## Framework lessons

- An explicit invalidation level makes a thesis falsifiable.

## Verification limitations

- Retrieved 2026-11-07; publication-date wording is not authenticated.
- Public market series are available, but not every investment claim has a defined horizon or reconciled corporate-action-adjusted return. Unverified outcomes remain unscored; macro data use latest available vintages.
